OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA 90274
Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.
REMOTE MEETING PARTICIPATION INFORMATION
Zoom Meeting Link: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/81358648515
Meeting ID: 813 5864 8515
Dial-In Number(s): (669) 900-9128
HOW TO PARTICIPATE BEFORE THE MEETING: Members of the public are encouraged to submit email correspondence to CityClerks@pvestates.org before the meeting begins. The email will be distributed to all council members. Public correspondence submitted electronically via email will be provided to the legislative body, but will not be read aloud at the meeting.
HOW TO PARTICIPATE DURING THE MEETING: If you would like to address the City Council during the meeting, please utilize the "Raise Hand" feature during the meeting, or email CityClerks@pvestates.org with (1) the agenda item on which you'd like to speak, and (2) the phone number and/or Zoom display name from which you will be calling in to the meeting. This will replace the in-person speaker cards.
Agenda reports and other disclosable public documents relating to each Agenda Item are available on the City's website under City Council Meeting Agendas at www.pvestates.org.

4.
COPS FUND FOR RADIO SERVICE UPGRADES AND SAFETY HELMETS
Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council:
(1) Authorize a budget amendment to utilize Fund 05 - Supplemental Law Enforcement Services Account (SLESA) (also known as Citizens Options for Public Safety (COPS) funds) to purchase the following items:
a. A 5-year Motorola Advanced Plus Services package not-to-exceed $190,000.00;
b. An extended 5-year Warranty Plan for Audio Recording of 9-1-1 calls and police radio transmissions not-to-exceed $40,000; and
c. Ballistic safety helmets and shields not-to-exceed $45,000; and,
(2) Adopt Resolution R26-31 to approve the use of COPS funds not to exceed $275,000 for the purchase of the above items and amounts; and
(3) Authorize the City Manager to execute related documents on behalf of the City and authorize the Finance Department to make such accounting entries for this purchase and installation as deemed appropriate.
